b.x: An emergency button inside an app does not call 192 without a signal. Phone satellite SOS, in Brazil, is still not a plan. This does not replace the First aid tab or Red emergency. Do not install twelve tactical icons. Do not give location all the time. Do not post that you downloaded them.
The card already on the phone

It is not a store. It is the phone itself. On iPhone, Medical ID. On Android, Emergency information. Name, blood type if you are sure, allergy, diabetes, medicine, one contact. It shows on the lock screen, without the password, without a network. Fill it at home. The helper should not have to unlock your life.
A downloaded map, not a live map

GPS works without a signal. The drawing of the street does not. At home, on Wi-Fi, download the whole region: house, work, school, the highway, the hospital. Organic Maps does this without an account and without asking you to sign in. If the family already knows the phone’s map, download that one’s offline area, and test it for real: airplane mode, open the route, see if the street is there. A map of one trail only leaves you blind on the next street.
First aid that opens with no network

This house’s guide, the First aid and Red emergency tabs, stays on the device after the first visit. Open both once on Wi-Fi. Besides that, the International Federation of Red Cross First Aid app keeps the steps on the phone: bleeding, burn, choking, compressions. Open one lesson at home so it saves. Do not use a chat robot that only answers if the cloud is standing. An app that is not in the store yet is not a plan.
Civil Defense alert is not offline

Register the postal code before. An SMS to 40199, or the phone’s own alert when the tower sends it. That warns of rain, flood, a slide. It needs the antenna. It does not need Wi-Fi, and it also does not work when the neighborhood is mute. When the tower falls, the warning stops. What continues is the battery radio and the plan you already read. Do not depend on twelve weather apps.
Three words do not save without someone to hear

what3words marks a three-meter square. It helps if you already downloaded the area and if someone with a signal receives the three words. With no signal, the words are a note. Write them on paper and hand them to whoever is going to the tower. Do not treat the app as the rescue.
A message with no tower, only if the house rehearsed

There are apps that talk from phone to phone, nearby, with no carrier. Briar is one, quieter. It only counts if both people installed it on a Tuesday and sent a test sentence. Installing it on the night of the flood is not a plan. Short range. It spends the battery. It is not a neighborhood radio.
The Tuesday test
01 Airplane mode. Open the map. The street of the house has to appear.
02 Open this first-aid tab and the numbers tab. Without spinning up the network.
03 Open one lesson in the Red Cross app. If it asks to download, you are not ready yet.
04 A charged power bank. An app dead from the battery is weight.
05 The same numbers, 192, 190 and 193, on a paper on the refrigerator. The phone can get wet.
